description: The file contains unit tests for the LocationHandler class in an Android app, verifying its behavior under various permission and location data scenarios.

classes.name: LocationHandlerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for LocationHandler, tests various location permission and fetching scenarios.

classes.name: FakeLocationDataSource
classes.description: A mock implementation of LocationDataSource used for testing, simulating location permission grants and location fetching behavior.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_requiresLocationPermissionWhenNeitherFineNorCoarse
methods.description: Tests that location fetch fails with 'LOCATION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED' when neither fine nor coarse permissions are granted.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_requiresForegroundBeforeLocationPermission
methods.description: Tests that location fetch fails with 'LOCATION_BACKGROUND_UNAVAILABLE' when app is not in foreground.

methods.name: hasFineLocationPermission_reflectsDataSource
methods.description: Verifies that the permission checks reflect the state of the FakeLocationDataSource.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_usesPreciseGpsFirstWhenFinePermissionAndPreciseEnabled
methods.description: Ensures that when fine permission and precise mode are enabled, GPS provider is preferred and parameters are set accordingly.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_fallsBackToBalancedWhenPreciseUnavailable
methods.description: Checks fallback to less precise location providers when precise GPS is not available.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_mapsTimeoutToLocationTimeout
methods.description: Validates that a timeout maps to 'LOCATION_TIMEOUT' error.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_mapsOtherFailuresToLocationUnavailable
methods.description: Verifies other failures map to 'LOCATION_UNAVAILABLE' error.
